what: Robustness study of the E14 findings, pre-registered (experiments/inbox7/PREREGISTRATION.md). CHANGELOG E15. Stage 1: arms A-BTC, B0, B1, B2, B0p, C with G and S1-S4. Stage 2: arms A (BTC, ETH, SOL), B0, B1, B2 with G, G' and T1-T4.
worktree: git worktree add --detach /tmp/vf-pbo 018f4ea (removed after the run)
python: python3 -I (anaconda 3.11); numpy 2.4.4, scipy 1.17.1, catboost 1.2.10, lightgbm 4.6.0, scikit-learn 1.8.0
data_note: Daily CSVs written from the Binance daily OHLCV files read by experiments/data_sources.py; sha256 listed above, identical to E14 (results/true_pbo/summary.json). (Local path removed for publication.)

commands.stage1_series: python3 -I experiments/inbox7/run.py series --stage 1 --arm {A,B0,B1 | C,B2,B0p} --out results/inbox7/parts/s1_<arm>  (2 workers, arms in sequence per worker)
commands.stage2_series: python3 -I experiments/inbox7/run.py series --stage 2 --arm {A --asset BTC, A --asset SOL, B0 | A --asset ETH, B1, B2} --out results/inbox7/parts/s2_<arm>  (2 workers)

deviations: Implementation choices the pre-registration left open: experiments/inbox7/run.py DEVIATIONS and CHANGELOG E15.

pre_run_checks.replication: PASS: S1 and T1 on the E14 base, BTC seeds 0-4: PBO and permuted 95th percentile identical to results/true_pbo/null.csv; AUC within 5.6e-17 (CSV round trip of the stored value) (logs/repl.txt)
pre_run_checks.timing: 1.68 h projected (2 workers, one series per arm timed) against the pre-registered 3.6 h, limit 7.2 h (logs/time_stage1.txt)

stage1.sleep_note: The machine slept during part of this stage. Five series spanned the sleep; the three also run in stage 2 (B1) gave identical AUC and net Sharpe ratios there, and the computation is deterministic.
stage1.recompute: S1, S2, S4 by Eq. 1 from *_is / *_oos and S3 by CSCV: 0 mismatches of 3,200 PBO values (800 series x 4)

pre_run_checks.timing: 2.15 h projected (2 workers, one series per arm timed) against the pre-registered 4.0 h, limit 8.0 h (logs/time_stage2.txt)

stage2.recompute: T1-T4 verdicts from the stored 100 permuted AUCs per series: 0 mismatches of 3,600; G, AUC and net Sharpe of the 500 series run in both stages identical (largest difference 0.0)

published_reduction: stage1_arrays.npz stores, for S3, the per-block counts, sums and sums of squares (*_S3_n, *_S3_sum, *_S3_sumsq; 16 row blocks) instead of the per-event returns on bootstrap series; experiments/inbox7/recompute.py recomputes every S3 PBO from them. run.py writes *_S3_R (events x 8); the published statistics are those of np.array_split of its rows into 16 blocks, so a re-run is compared after that reduction.
paths_note: Script and output paths renamed for publication (tools/inbox7 -> experiments/inbox7, canon/inbox7 -> results/inbox7, canon/true_pbo -> results/true_pbo, tools/true_pbo -> experiments/true_pbo; the public copy adds E14's private-input guards, which this study does not reach). valid_journal_commit_at_run refers to the private working repository.
